GOAL: Repair verify-otac so an observable expired OTAC produces 401 AUTH_EXPIRED without weakening invalid-code, replay, device-mismatch, or lockout behavior.
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: Red-first test proves current SHA returns AUTH_INVALID for an expired OTAC and expected DOC-C oracle is AUTH_EXPIRED.
Repair preserves fixed-slot verification structure and does not expose OTAC plaintext.
Expired-only case returns 401 AUTH_EXPIRED; live wrong code remains 401 AUTH_INVALID; device mismatch and OTAC lock semantics remain unchanged.
Consumed OTAC replay remains AUTH_INVALID plus security audit as required by DOC-C 8.4.
Affected auth/contract tests execute on the exact worker candidate SHA.
Candidate is independently reviewed and red-teamed before integration.
DESIGN_NOTE: Rust ZeroTrustGate already exposes AuthResult::Expired when matching email sessions exist but all are expired; use as parity evidence only, never as authority over DOC-C.
